TheRocket MegiSemi - CONTEST BUILD
laoforextrader.com/contest

This build reports your result to the contest leaderboard. It is for the
contest demo account only.

1. Copy TheRocketMegiSemiContest.ex5 into
     <MT5 data folder>\MQL5\Experts
   (File > Open Data Folder in MetaTrader), then restart MT5.

2. Tools > Options > Expert Advisors:
     tick  Allow WebRequest for listed URL
     add   https://www.laoforextrader.com
   Without this the EA trades but reports nothing, and the entry cannot
   be approved.

3. Open an XAUUSDm chart on M5, drag the EA on, and paste the
   ContestCode you were sent on WhatsApp.

4. Turn Algo Trading on. Within a minute the panel shows CONTEST with
   your rank.

Easier: run this one line in PowerShell and it does step 1 for every
MetaTrader on the PC:
     irm https://www.laoforextrader.com/contest-ea | iex

Full guide with pictures: https://www.laoforextrader.com/contest/install

RISK
  This EA averages down and has no stop loss by design. The risk it carries is
  the whole account, not a fixed amount per trade. Use money you can afford to
  lose entirely and keep the lots small. Past results do not describe the
  future: testing was done on a window in which gold rose strongly, and the
  same settings lost money in other periods.
